description: This file contains helper functions to create and manage large numbers of git packs, primarily for testing or performance analysis purposes.

methods.name: create_packs
methods.description: Creates a specified number of packs with each containing a single blob and checkpoint, using Perl to generate the data and git fast-import to import the packs.

methods.name: setup_many_packs
methods.description: Configures git to disable automatic garbage collection and related features, then creates 500 packs using the create_packs function.
